==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Two groups of six teams each
* Groups based on [[LPL/2016 Season/Summer Season|Summer 2016]] and [[2016 Season China Regional Finals|Regional Finals]] performances
** One team from Tier 1 ([[EDward Gaming]] and [[Royal Never Give Up]])
** Two teams from Tier 2 ([[I May]], [[Team WE]], [[Snake Esports]], and [[Vici Gaming]])
** Two teams from Tier 3 ([[Invictus Gaming]], [[Newbee]], [[Game Talents]], and [[LGD Gaming]])
** One team from Tier 4 ([[Oh My God]] and [[QG Reapers]])
* Each team plays 16 matches.
** Double Round Robin within own group
** Single Round Robin against other group
* Best of 3
* Top 4 from each group qualifies to the [[LPL/2017 Season/Spring Playoffs|playoffs]]
* Group winners receive playoff byes into the semifinals
* Second place teams receive playoff byes into the quarterfinals
* Fifth and sixth-place teams play in [[LPL/2017 Season/Summer Promotion|Summer Promotion]]
* {{TiebreakerRules|
:* If two teams have the same number of series won, ties will be broken by:
::# Game Differential (Individual Game Wins minus Losses)
::# Head to Head record
::# Number of games won
::# If still tied, a best of three tiebreaker series will be played, with side selection determined by coin toss}}

===Peak viewers===
Data about number of viewers is based on information from Esports Charts<ref>[http://esc.watch/tournaments/lol/lpl-2017-spring-season LPL Spring Split 2017] ''esc.watch''</ref>:
* The tournament's Overall peak was 18 790 765 viewers
* The tournament's peak Without Chinese viewers was 76 185 viewers
* English streams peak was 32 436 viewers
* Chinese streams peak was 18 781 196 viewers
* Youtube peak was 68 171 viewers
